description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Stoneskin: 30%] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)] and [Quick Cast 1]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] and [Quick Cast] to all allies if 0-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Knight] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Stoneskin: 30%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 30% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Knight
description.text: Knight abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time
